title: Google's Gemini: from Gemini 3 to the Gemini 4 family
dek: Google went from Gemini 3 to three Gemini 4 models in under a year, while pushing AI into Search, Android and free video tools.
bigLabel: Google's newest model family, announced from 30 Sep 2026

glance.what: Google launched Gemini 3 in November 2025, then a fast series of cheaper 'Flash' models, and in late 2026 the Gemini 4 family: Argon (30 September), Carbon (28 October) and the faster, cheaper Hydrogen (12 November).
glance.why: Gemini sits inside Search, Android, Gmail and YouTube, so Google's models reach more people by default than any rival's.
glance.next: Wider Gemini 4 Carbon availability, and Hydrogen rolling out globally in Search and the Gemini app.

forYou: Many Gemini features arrive free on Android phones and in Google apps. The most capable models usually go first to paid Google AI Ultra subscribers and developers.

events.title: Gemini 3 and the Antigravity coding tool
events.summary: Google releases Gemini 3 Pro and Deep Think, with a 1-million-token context, alongside Antigravity, an AI coding app.

events.title: Gemini 3 Flash becomes the default
events.summary: A cheaper, near-Pro model becomes the default in the Gemini app and powers AI Mode in Search.

events.title: Gemini 3 Deep Think
events.summary: An updated deep-reasoning version of Gemini 3.

events.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
events.summary: A new everyday model for coding, agents and web development.

events.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash
events.summary: The third Flash release in six weeks; Google calls it its best reasoning and coding model at that speed and price.

events.title: Gemini 4 Argon
events.summary: Google's new frontier model for software engineering, business work and cyber defence goes first to trusted cyber defenders, then to developers and paid subscribers from 13 October.

events.title: Gemini 4 Carbon announced
events.summary: A second Gemini 4 model, focused on cybersecurity and long tasks. It reaches Ultra subscribers and developers on 10 November.

sources.name: IT Cares (from Google's and Anthropic's pages)

events.title: Free AI video in Google Vids
events.summary: Three free 15-second AI video clips a month in Google Vids, and a 'sketch to app' feature in Gemini.

sources.name: IT Cares (from Google's and Anthropic's pages)

events.title: AlphaGenome 2 and a lawsuit
events.summary: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, a DNA model. Google is among five companies named in the AI freeze lawsuit.

events.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the new everyday model
events.summary: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cheaper model built for AI agents that replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash as its everyday model. It is rolling out globally in Google Search for all users, in the Gemini app (free users get it through automatic model selection) and to developers at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Google says it finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than 3.8 Flash; these are Google's own figures.
